select id, goods_info, goods_quantity, receipts_time, receipts_status, remake, create_by_name as createBy, DATE_FORMAT(receipts_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as receiptsTimeStr from r_receipts_info where is_deleted = 0
and DATE_FORMAT(receipts_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{params.startTime}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and DATE_FORMAT(receipts_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{params.endTime}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and goods_info like concat('%', #{params.goodsInfo}, '%')
and receipts_number like concat('%', #{params.receiptsNumber}, '%')
order by create_time desc
